title: Validate dates against the Japanese calendar boundary
goal: Validate historical dates against the active Japanese calendar range and retain unsupported Gregorian values when importing records after a runtime upgrade.

selectionNotes: Validate historical dates against the active Japanese calendar range and retain unsupported Gregorian values when importing records after a runtime upgrade.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: The minimum supported JapaneseCalendar date changes with the .NET 11 runtime.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build net11.0 references; pinned RC2 identifies measured evidence separately.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample mode; this policy uses established C# features.

platforms: Framework-supported platforms; actual execution measured only on Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT
prerequisites: SDK console project with ImplicitUsings and Nullable enabled; use System.Globalization and namespace Playbook.Samples.
A globalization mode that can instantiate ja-JP and JapaneseCalendar; invariant mode is unsupported.
Retain original Gregorian records and route unsupported Japanese-calendar projections explicitly.
constraints: Boundary checks execute GetYear/GetEra and the importer at 1868-09-08, 1868-10-01, 1868-10-22 and 1868-10-23, with inclusive maximum and old unsupported-date controls.
Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT/ICU is measured, including forced invariant-mode refusal. NLS and other platforms are not tested.
No package, provider, rendering mode, native toolchain, workload or experimental opt-in. The previous comparison adds no target10 foundation.
stabilityLimitations: Verified using .NET 11 RC2; GA reconciliation remains pending. These selected contracts have no publisher experimental annotation or required opt-in.

evidence.scope: Actual paired calendar operations, queried minima, all four historical boundaries, explicit routing without clamping, stored-value preservation, measured ICU/globalization mode and invariant-mode refusal.
